title: HarnessGateResult
description: Output written by Claude to .sessi-work/gate{N}_result.json after inline gate evaluation.

overall_score.description: Weighted composite score across all dimensions.

quality_complete.description: True when meets_target AND open_critical_count==0 AND open_high_count==0.

open_critical_count.description: Number of unresolved critical severity issues.

open_high_count.description: Number of unresolved high severity issues.

breakdown.description: Per-dimension score detail keyed by dimension name.

failing_dimensions.description: Names of dimensions that did not meet their individual thresholds.

gate_num.description: Gate number this result belongs to.

fr_id.description: Functional requirement ID if gate is FR-scoped.
